inputs_and_expected: Implement sc_matches for text0..64 bytes and pattern0..16 bytes. Numeric zero is data. Text [0,97,0,97,0], pattern [97,0] produces [1,3]; pattern [0,97,0] produces [0,2]; empty pattern produces [0,1,2,3,4,5]. For text aaaa and pattern aa return [0,1,2]. A capacity one below the required match count returns SC_FULL and preserves count and every output byte. A longer pattern returns success with count0. The earlier algo_match exposes only a first-match index. The original parent project asks for a required count on failure; this additive API deliberately preserves the count too. Supply a separate documented adapter if the parent interface is required, computing required count through a read-only pass before publishing that different result. Do not claim API equivalence.
limits: Bounded independent model, same author, not an independent human assessment.
